editorial.blurb: Iron Age brings sizzling Korean BBQ to your table at an unbeatable all-you-can-eat price, where tableside grilling and generous portions of bulgogi, brisket, and marinated meats are the stars.
editorial.insiderTip: Order strategically and confirm portion sizes with your server before they arrive — portions are notably large, and the restaurant charges extra for uneaten food. Lunch offers an even better discount than dinner.
